{{MissingInfo|2|java|enva}} {{AnimePokémonInfobox |type1=Bug |type2=Poison |trainername=Goh |pokemonname=Venomoth |jtrainername=ゴウ |jpokemonname=モルフォン |tmtrainername=Go |tmpokemonname=Morphon |image=[[File:Goh Venomoth.png|250px]] |caption=Goh's Venomoth |prevonum=049 |epnum=JN006 |epname=Working My Way Back to Mew! |location=[[Vermilion Forest]] |current=[[Cerise Laboratory|Cerise Park]] |gender=Unknown |ability=Unknown |noevo=incap |java1=Unknown |enva1=Unknown }} '''Goh's Venomoth''' (Japanese: '''ゴウのモルフォン''' ''Go's Morphon'') is the third {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} that [[Goh]] {{pkmn2|caught}} in the [[Kanto]] [[region]], and his fourth overall. ==History== ==={{aniseries|JN}}=== [[File:Goh Butterfree and Venomoth.png|thumb|left|250px|Venomoth and Butterfree]] In ''[[JN006|Working My Way Back to Mew!]]'', Goh found {{p|Venomoth}} at [[Vermilion Forest]], and after a brief chase, threw a {{i|Poké Ball}} at it, successfully catching it. In ''[[JN023|Panic in the Park!]]'', Venomoth joined a group made up of Goh's other {{type|Bug}} Pokémon, which came into conflict with another faction led by [[Goh's Darmanitan]], which was made up of {{t|Normal}} and {{type|Poison}} Pokémon, after the food around [[Cerise Laboratory|Cerise Park]] had been stolen. Venomoth and {{TP|Goh|Butterfree}} combined their {{m|Stun Spore}} attacks, which were blocked by {{TP|Goh|Grimer}}'s {{m|Poison Gas}}. As the battle escalated, {{TP|Goh|Scyther}} took control of the Bug-type group, but the infighting ended when {{TP|Goh|Golurk}} lost control of itself, causing Cerise Park to become flooded. Venomoth joined the rest of the Pokémon in saving Goh's three {{p|Cascoon}}, allowing them to [[Evolution|evolve]] into {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Dustox}} and clear the storm with {{m|Sunny Day}}. In ''[[JN029|There's a New Kid in Town!]]'', Goh enlisted the help of Venomoth and Butterfree by having them use Stun Spore to locate the invisible crying {{TP|Goh|Sobble}}, as its crying was affecting all the Pokémon in the proximity, and its paralysis caused Sobble to reappear, but it kept crying until {{AP|Dragonite}} hugged the Water Lizard Pokémon to comfort it, which caused Sobble to fall asleep and stop crying. In ''[[JN136|This Could be the Start of Something Big!]]'', Venomoth attended a surprise party hosted by the Lab members commemorating Goh and {{Ash}}'s departure. After that, Venomoth posed for a group photo with Goh, Ash, and the others. ==Personality and characteristics== Venomoth is shown as being useful for restraining its targets with its {{m|Stun Spore}} attack, seen when Venomoth helped locate the camouflaged {{TP|Goh|Sobble}} when its crying was affecting everyone around it. Venomoth is usually seen alongside {{TP|Goh|Butterfree}}, and they often combined their Stun Spore attacks together to cover a wider area whenever Goh deems it necessary. They also perform this combo on their own accord, seen when Venomoth and Butterfree used it during their confrontation with the {{t|Normal}}- and {{type|Poison}} faction in ''[[JN023|Panic in the Park!]]''. ==Moves used== {{anmov/h|bug|poison|Goh Venomoth Stun Spore.png|Using Stun Spore}} {{anmov|grass|Stun Spore|JN023|Panic in the Park!}} {{anmov/f|poison}} ==Artwork== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; {{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{bug color dark}}; background: #{{bug color}}; font-size:80%;" |- | style="{{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{bug color dark}}; background: #{{bug color light}}"| [[File:JN006 illustration.png|x250px]] |- | Official artwork of
